text.zh-CN:
阑尾炎是大肠起始部旁一条小管状结构发生炎症，通常需医院紧急处理。

- 疼痛常先在肚脐周围，随后转到右下腹并加重。
- 可伴食欲下降、恶心、呕吐或发热，不典型表现也不能排除。
text.en:
Appendicitis inflames a small pouch near the large bowel and usually needs urgent hospital care.

- Pain often starts near the navel then moves to the lower right abdomen.
- Poor appetite, nausea, vomiting or fever may occur; atypical symptoms do not exclude it.

text.zh-CN:
阑尾堵塞可能使内部肿胀和感染。

- 粪块或肿大组织可能造成堵塞，具体原因常不明确。
- 任何年龄都可发生，年轻人较常见。
- 不能简单归咎于某顿饭，也不是排便就能解决的积食。
text.en:
Blockage can cause swelling and infection.

- Stool or swollen tissue may obstruct the appendix, though the exact cause is often unclear.
- It can occur at any age, commonly in younger people.
- It is not simply a bad meal or indigestion relieved by defecation.

text.zh-CN:
严重或全腹疼痛需要立即急诊。

- 短暂减轻后变成全腹剧痛可能提示穿孔。
- 意识混乱、异常苍白斑驳或呼吸困难可能提示严重感染。
- 不要自行开车，也不要等发热达到某个数字。
text.en:
Severe or widespread abdominal pain needs emergency care.

- Brief relief followed by whole-abdomen pain may indicate rupture.
- Confusion, mottled or unusually pale skin or breathing difficulty may indicate severe infection.
- Do not drive yourself or wait for a particular temperature.

text.zh-CN:
持续加重的腹痛需及时就医。

- 疼痛不消失或移到右下腹，应及时联系急症服务。
- 幼儿、老人和孕妇位置或强度可能不典型。
- 初次检查后症状继续变化，需要重新评估。
text.en:
Persistent worsening abdominal pain needs prompt medical assessment.

- Non-resolving pain or migration to the lower right abdomen needs urgent assessment.
- Children, older adults and pregnant patients may have atypical pain.
- Return for reassessment when symptoms evolve after initial testing.

text.zh-CN:
诊断综合病史、腹部检查和检测。

- 血检寻找炎症，尿检排查泌尿问题。
- 超声或CT观察阑尾；有怀孕可能时需告知医生。
- 没有一项检查始终准确，医院可能观察数小时并复查。
text.en:
Diagnosis combines history, examination and tests.

- Blood tests assess inflammation and urine tests consider urinary disease.
- Ultrasound or CT evaluates the appendix; disclose possible pregnancy.
- No test is always conclusive; hospital observation and repeat assessment may be needed.

text.zh-CN:
右下腹痛可能来自肠道、泌尿或生殖系统，线索有助医生判断，不能自行排除阑尾炎。

- 腹泻伴腹痛可见于肠道感染或炎症，但阑尾炎也可能腹泻。
- 尿痛、尿频更提示泌尿道感染；侧腰痛向大腿根部扩散、阵发加重可见于肾结石。
- 有怀孕可能，尤其停经、异常阴道出血伴一侧下腹痛，需优先排除异位妊娠；卵巢囊肿等也可相似。
- 这些表现可以重叠，持续或加重的腹痛仍需及时检查。
text.en:
Lower-right pain may arise from bowel, urinary or reproductive organs; clues guide clinicians but cannot exclude appendicitis at home.

- Diarrhoea with pain occurs in bowel infection or inflammation, but appendicitis can also cause diarrhoea.
- Burning or frequent urination suggests urinary infection; side or back pain spreading to the groin in waves can occur with kidney stones.
- Possible pregnancy, especially a missed period, unusual vaginal bleeding and one-sided lower pain, requires assessment for ectopic pregnancy; ovarian cysts can overlap.
- Symptoms can overlap, so persistent or worsening pain still needs prompt assessment.

text.zh-CN:
治疗控制感染并防止破裂。

- 常用手术切除，可腹腔镜或开放方式。
- 严格选择的病例可用抗生素，但需医院判断和随访。
- 脓肿或炎性包块可能改变处理顺序，不能在家自行决定保守治疗。
text.en:
Treatment controls infection and prevents rupture.

- Removal may use keyhole or open surgery.
- Antibiotics alone may suit selected cases under hospital follow-up.
- Abscesses or inflammatory masses can change the sequence; conservative treatment is not a home decision.

text.zh-CN:
药物是医院治疗的一部分。

- 抗生素控制细菌感染，不保证所有患者免手术，也可导致腹泻或过敏。
- 止痛、止吐和补液帮助缓解不适。
- 不要用剩余抗生素、泻药或灌肠试治而延误评估。
text.en:
Medicines form part of hospital care.

- Antibiotics control infection but do not always avoid surgery and may cause diarrhoea or allergy.
- Analgesia, antiemetics and fluids improve comfort.
- Do not delay assessment with leftover antibiotics, laxatives or enemas.

text.zh-CN:
急性期与恢复期要求不同。

- 可能手术时遵从医疗团队的禁食饮水安排。
- 术后按允许的进度恢复饮食。
- 恢复期便秘可讨论纤维和水分，但腹胀呕吐时不能盲目大量进食。
text.en:
Acute and recovery-phase eating differ.

- Follow the team’s fasting instructions when surgery is possible.
- Resume food after surgery as advised.
- Discuss fibre and fluids for recovery constipation, but do not force food with distension and vomiting.

text.zh-CN:
出院护理关注伤口和功能。

- 保持伤口和敷料清洁，湿敷料按说明更换。
- 逐步活动，运动和提重物听从手术团队指导。
- 红肿加重、流脓、发热或腹痛加剧应联系医院。
text.en:
Discharge care focuses on wounds and function.

- Follow wound cleaning and dressing instructions.
- Increase activity gradually and follow advice on lifting and sport.
- Contact the hospital for worsening redness, pus, fever or abdominal pain.

text.zh-CN:
部分人群不一定有典型右下腹痛。

- 幼儿可能主要不吃、哭闹或呕吐。
- 老人疼痛可能较轻，却出现意识变化。
- 孕妇疼痛位置可不同，检查与治疗由相关团队共同安排。
text.en:
Typical lower-right pain may be absent.

- Young children may refuse food, cry or vomit.
- Older adults may have less pain but altered mental state.
- Pregnancy may change pain location and requires coordinated assessment and treatment.

text.zh-CN:
及时治疗者多数恢复良好。

- 无并发症者常一两周逐渐恢复，穿孔后可能更久。
- 按出院要求复查伤口和恢复情况。
- 抗生素治疗后再出现类似腹痛应复评，因为可能复发。
text.en:
Most promptly treated patients recover well.

- Uncomplicated recovery often progresses over one to two weeks; rupture may prolong it.
- Follow discharge review arrangements.
- Similar pain after antibiotic treatment requires reassessment because recurrence is possible.

text.zh-CN:
主要危险是穿孔和感染扩散。

- 腹膜炎是腹腔内衬感染，常引起广泛疼痛。
- 脓肿是局部积脓；脓毒症是感染引发危及生命的全身反应。
- 手术亦可能有感染、出血或粘连。
text.en:
Rupture and spreading infection are major concerns.

- Peritonitis infects the abdominal lining and causes widespread pain.
- An abscess is a pus collection; sepsis is a life-threatening systemic response.
- Surgical infection, bleeding or adhesions are possible.

text.zh-CN:
目前没有保证避免阑尾炎的方法。

- 均衡饮食有益健康，但不能承诺阻止发病。
- 不常规用抗生素或保健品预防。
- 减少严重结局最实用的措施是对持续加重腹痛及时评估。
text.en:
There is no guaranteed prevention.

- Balanced eating supports health without promising protection.
- Routine antibiotics and supplements are not preventive measures.
- Prompt assessment of worsening persistent pain is the practical way to reduce severe outcomes.
